modules.name: Séance
modules.description: Spectral frame core: STFT analysis and resynthesis of input A (with B as a reference), handed in place to the Séance expanders on its right; seeded, with RESET for repeatable replay.

modules.name: Séance Freeze
modules.description: Spectral freeze expander: holds the frame and keeps its phases turning, with seeded drift.

modules.name: Séance Scramble
modules.description: Spectral scatter expander: moves every peak by a seeded offset, re-pitched coherently, with a diffuser.

modules.name: Séance Cross
modules.description: Cross-synthesis expander: B's spectrum shapes A's levels (multiply) or A's magnitudes morph towards B's.

modules.name: Séance Wipe
modules.description: Spectral wipe expander: a hard or soft wall across the spectrum that sweeps up or down under CV.

modules.name: Séance Bridge
modules.description: Spectral byte-bus expander: eight-band activity detector and smoothed bit mask on the shared frame.
